questions.stem: A 24-Year-old female presents to your clinic for a routine examination. She has a history of acne, for which she takes minocycline and isotretinoin daily. She also takes a combined oral contraceptive birth control pill containing norethindrone acetate and ethinyl estradiol. She is a nonsmoker but drinks alcohol occasionally. She is concerned about the effectiveness of her birth control pill, given all the medications that she takes. She is particularly worried about the effects of her medications on a developing fetus in the event of unintended pregnancy. Which of the following drugs has the lowest potential to cause birth defects?
